title: STILL PRESENT (r1): Exhaustion gate compares RFC3339 'at' against Postgres ::text corrected_at — same-day stale bounces still exhaust the corrected row and stamp fabricated referee_contact_invalid
evidence: webhooks.gleam:303-304: "// ISO timestamps — lexical compare is chronological." / "string.compare(at, corrected) != order.Lt". sweep.gleam now_iso(): "timestamp.system_time() |> timestamp.to_rfc3339(calendar.utc_offset)" → '2026-08-12T09:00:00.123456Z' (T separator, Z). find_reference_call_by_send_ref.sql: "COALESCE(rc.corrected_at::text, '') AS corrected_at" → Postgres '2026-08-12 10:00:00.123456+00' (space separator).
detail: The two formats differ at index 10 ('T' 0x54 vs ' ' 0x20), so ANY same-calendar-day comparison yields at > corrected regardless of instants: a redelivered pre-correction bounce hours earlier the same day classifies as genuine and exhaust_reference_call terminalizes the corrected row as unreachable with referee_contact_invalid — the exact r1 W3 false-positive the gate was built to prevent (only cross-day bounces now stand down).
recommended_fix: Normalize before comparing (e.g. compare e->>'at' and corrected_at::text both via to_char/to_timestamp, or cast both to timestamptz in SQL) and pin a same-day stale-bounce stand-down test.

title: Substitute idempotent 'existing' path re-stamps fraud_signals on the existing successor — documented no-op is not a no-op
evidence: actions_handler.gleam:415-421: "Ok(new_id) -> { // r1 (N1): the new row gets the same creation-time fraud screening the // viewed trigger applies (parity — best-effort, post-commit). trigger.stamp_creation_fraud_for( config, app_uuid, landlord_uuid, vacancy_uuid, [new_id], )" — this runs for BOTH the how='inserted' AND the how='existing' (double-submit) branch. stamp_creation_fraud_signals.sql: "SET fraud_signals = $2::jsonb" (full overwrite).
detail: The how='existing' branch is documented as a pure no-op ('No trio rewrite, no duplicate audit — the original did both') but still re-stamps the existing successor with a full-overwrite creation-signals write plus a fresh Twilio line-type lookup; a full overwrite could wipe form_session evidence written between two submits.
recommended_fix: Gate stamp_creation_fraud_for on new_row.how == "inserted" (only freshly-created rows), matching the trigger's created_ids-only scope.

title: STILL PRESENT (r1): Live-slot idempotent INSERT + 8-status ON CONFLICT predicate maintained in three SQL files
evidence: substitute_reference_call.sql:37: "ON CONFLICT (application_id, ref_slot, owner_label) WHERE status NOT IN ( 'form_completed', 'unreachable', 'refused', 'objected', 'manual_recorded', 'failed', 'completed', 'partial' )" — byte-identical to the other two files and to idx_reference_call_live (20260731222000_create_reference_call.sql:138), but still triplicated.
detail: The substitute query still carries its own copy of the live-slot insert semantics instead of reusing the existing query; the predicates are consistent today, but a future status-list change must be made in three places plus the index — the drift risk N10 flagged is unchanged.
recommended_fix: Extract the predicate into a shared SQL view/comment-pinned constant or add a schema test asserting all three files' predicates equal the index definition.
